StorageTools.Title: Mass storage
StorageTools.Description: The device's volumes in a file browser, and copies to and from them — every copy read back from the media and checked by SHA-256.
StorageTools.Note.NoDisk: Windows has not made a disk of this function yet.
StorageTools.Note.NoVolume: The disk has no volume Windows could mount — no media, or a file system Windows does not read.
